videos.script:
The planner has been checked by hand, one command at a time. Today the checks become tools, and the tools become one command that git runs for you.

{{lint}} First what a linter catches: a ref read while rendering, a mistake TypeScript cannot see, found by the linter the project has had since lesson one.

{{eslint}} Then ESLint, the linter with every plugin. The same finding, an error this time, and a measurement of what the extra plugins cost in time.

{{prettier}} Then Prettier, which settles where the lines break so that nobody has to. Three settings, four files changed.

{{biome}} Then Biome, one tool that does both jobs, and the choice between one tool and several.

{{hook}} And last, one command for every check, and a git hook that refuses a commit until it passes.
